definition_zh: v. 炮击；轰炸；连珠炮似地提问或攻击；n.（旧）臼炮
definition_en: to attack with heavy guns or bombs, or with a stream of questions
core_image: 城墙上空接连落下的石弹
scene: 敌军把臼炮拖到城墙下，石弹如雨点般砸来。Enemy forces bombarded the city for three days.
sceneCN: 这里 bombard 是「炮击」（第 1 个义项：以重炮连续轰击）；句意是敌军对该城连续炮击三天。

derivatives.zh: bombard 加 -ment，义为「炮击；轰炸；轰击」
bombard 加 -er，义为「炮击者；轰击者」

senses.title: To attack with heavy guns
senses.definition: to attack a place with continuous heavy gunfire or bombs
senses.definitionCN: 以持续的猛烈炮火或炸弹攻击某地
senses.example: Enemy forces bombarded the city for three days.
senses.exampleCN: 敌军对该城连续炮击三天。
senses.why: The medieval bombard hurled great stones; the verb keeps its hurling.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪的臼炮投掷巨石，动词保留了这股「投掷」之力。

senses.title: To fire a stream of questions
senses.definition: to direct many questions or demands at someone at once
senses.definitionCN: 向某人同时提出大量问题或要求
senses.example: Reporters bombarded the minister with questions.
senses.exampleCN: 记者们连珠炮似地追问部长。
senses.why: A volley of words is imagined as a volley of shot.
senses.whyCN: 连发的言辞被想象成连发的炮弹。

senses.title: To expose matter to particles
senses.definition: to direct beams of particles or radiation at a material
senses.definitionCN: 以粒子束或射线照射物质
senses.example: Scientists bombarded the foil with alpha particles.
senses.exampleCN: 科学家用阿尔法粒子轰击金箔。
senses.why: Physics borrowed artillery language for its invisible cannonades.
senses.whyCN: 物理学借用炮兵语言描述无形的轰击。

senses.title: To overwhelm with advertising or noise
senses.definition: to subject someone to a flood of messages or stimuli
senses.definitionCN: 使人暴露于海量信息或刺激之中
senses.example: Commuters are bombarded with ads on every screen.
senses.exampleCN: 通勤者在每一块屏幕上都被广告轰炸。
senses.why: Sensory overload is bombardment by other means.
senses.whyCN: 感官过载不过是换了形式的炮击。

senses.title: The medieval bomb-throwing engine
senses.definition: an early cannon for hurling heavy stone or metal shot
senses.definitionCN: 投掷石弹或金属弹的早期火炮
senses.example: The trebuchet gave way to the bombard in the 1400s.
senses.exampleCN: 15 世纪投石机被臼炮取代。
senses.why: The noun is the parent: the engine first, the action after.
senses.whyCN: 名词是母体：先有炮，后有炮击之事。

senses.title: To besiege persistently
senses.definition: to attack or press someone relentlessly over time
senses.definitionCN: 长时期不断攻击或纠缠某人
senses.example: The ministry was bombarded by petitions for months.
senses.exampleCN: 数月来请愿书雪片般飞向该部。
senses.why: A siege is bombardment stretched over calendar time.
senses.whyCN: 围攻不过是把炮击拉长到日历的尺度。

senses.title: To hit with fast-moving objects
senses.definition: to strike repeatedly with fast-moving things, literal or figurative
senses.definitionCN: 被高速物体反复击打（实指或比喻）
senses.exampleCN: 冰雹砸打着温室的顶棚。
senses.why: Anything falling in volleys is given the gunner's verb.
senses.whyCN: 凡成排坠落之物，都可借用炮手的动词。

senses.title: Nuclear and particle bombardment in industry
senses.definition: industrial use of particle beams to alter materials
senses.definitionCN: 以粒子束改变材料性质的工业用途
senses.example: Silicon wafers are bombarded to implant ions.
senses.exampleCN: 硅片经轰击以注入离子。
senses.why: The physics sense matured into a manufacturing tool.
senses.whyCN: 物理义成熟后化作制造工艺。

intro.en: Bombard comes through Old French bombarte from Latin bombus, a booming sound.
intro.cn: bombard 经古法语 bombarte 来自拉丁语 bombus「轰鸣声」。

items.en: a root of deep hollow humming, also behind boom and bomb.
items.cn: 印欧词根表低沉轰鸣，bomb、boom 亦同源。

items.en: bombos was the booming of a hollow thing.
items.cn: 希腊语 bombos 指空心物发出的嗡响。

items.en: bombus carried the booming into Latin.
items.cn: 拉丁语 bombus 承袭了这一轰鸣之义。

items.en: bombarte named the heavy catapult stone, then the cannon itself.
items.cn: 古法语 bombarte 先指重型投石，后指臼炮。

items.en: English took the cannon noun, then built the verb of attack and the wider senses.
items.cn: 英语于 15 世纪借入火炮名词，衍生出攻击动词及各引申义。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the bomb- root; the near-meaning group gathers attack words.
note.cn: 形近组共享 bomb- 词根；近义组收攻击类词。

entries.definition: the crewman who drops the bombs
to strike with a stream of things

normalIntro.en: Bombard grew from the booming old cannon called a bombard.
normalIntro.cn: bombard 源自名为 bombard 的轰鸣古炮。

normal.en: Bombard with questions is the common figurative use.
normal.cn: bombard with questions 是常见比喻用法。

normal.en: Physics uses it for particle beams.
normal.cn: 物理学用它指粒子束轰击。

normal.en: Stress falls on the second syllable.
The old cannon sense survives in history books.

abstract.en: See stone balls rise over a castle wall in slow arcs.
abstract.cn: 看石弹以缓慢弧线越过城堡的墙头。

abstract.en: Hear reporters shouting questions at once from ten directions.
abstract.cn: 听十个方向的记者同时发问。

abstract.en: Feel dust falling from the ceiling with each distant thud.
abstract.cn: 感受远处每声闷响震落的棚顶灰尘。

examples.en: Enemy forces bombarded the city for three days.
examples.cn: 敌军对该城连续炮击三天。

examples.en: Reporters bombarded the minister with questions.
examples.cn: 记者们连珠炮似地追问部长。

examples.en: Scientists bombarded the foil with alpha particles.
examples.cn: 科学家用阿尔法粒子轰击金箔。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「蹦吧的」——炮弹「蹦吧」一声落地，连轰三天不停。

root: 拉丁语 bombus「轰鸣」（希腊语 bombos，印欧词根表低沉轰鸣，与 bomb、boom 同源），经古法语 bombarte「重型投石、臼炮」进入英语（15 世纪）为火炮名词，后转出「炮击」动词及提问、射线等引申用法。

sensesIntro.en: From a booming stone-thrower to particle beams and question storms, bombard is the artillery verb of English.
sensesIntro.cn: 从轰鸣的抛石炮到粒子束与问题风暴，bombard 是英语里的炮兵动词。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: stone balls arcing over a castle wall
core.cn: 核心意象：越过城墙的石弹弧线

branches.en: Particle beams in lab and factory
branches.cn: 实验室与工厂的粒子束

intro.en: The bomb- root sounds like its own meaning.
intro.cn: bomb- 词根的发音即是它的意义。

latinIntro.cn: 希腊语经拉丁语、法语传入。
